_comment: --cms=none: the category page has no CMS-driven banner. Rather than ship a whole-file overlay (which froze against the boilerplate and drifted — the old overlay missed the SDK-0.14 pluralized Category fields, category.names/.descriptions/.shortDescriptions, and later the stock-availability filter, breaking `next build`), surgically remove only the three CMS-banner touch points: the lib/cms + CategoryBanner imports, the server-side banner fetch, and its render. Everything else (plural fields, stock filter, SEO resolvers, the CategoryIsland seed) then tracks the boilerplate automatically. A stale `find` here is a HARD ERROR at scaffold time (see textPatch.ts), so future boilerplate drift surfaces loudly instead of silently shipping a broken page.
